name: Isekai Senshu wa Kaerenai
original_name: 異世界戦手は帰れない
source:
You have been summoned to another world, where you must become a representative (fighter) of the demon king's camp and fight a proxy war (holy war) against the empire. It is said that they will give you training until the day of the war, but...

This is a multi-end romance game with male and female characters, whose stories branch out as you become closer to them.

The game contains some painful scenes depicting people being treated without dignity.

[translated from [url=https://kumakumaf.itch.io/isesen]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被召唤到异世界，在那里你必须成为魔王阵营的代表（战士），与帝国进行一场代理人战争（圣战）。据说他们会一直训练你直到战争爆发，但是……

这是一款多结局的爱情游戏，有男性和女性角色，随着你与他们的关系越来越亲密，他们的故事就会分支出来。

游戏中包含一些痛苦的场景，描绘了人们受到没有尊严的对待。

[译自[url=https://kumakumaf.itch.io/isesen]Itch.io[/url]]
